open-flow

    Welcome

    Local-first dictation for macOS. Press a hotkey, talk, get the cleaned text pasted into any text field.

    This setup takes ~3 minutes: grant two permissions, pick a quality tier, then the AI models download.

    Permissions

    Microphone Needed to record your voice.
    checking…
    Accessibility Lets the app press ⌘V to paste into the focused field.
    checking…

    Both permissions are granted in macOS System Settings. We re-check automatically when you return to this window.

    Choose quality

    Higher tiers are more accurate but larger to download. You can change this later in Preferences.

    Downloading models

    Preparing…

    Models are cached on your Mac — this only happens once. Keep this window open.

    You're set

    Hold Option (left or right) over any text field, speak, then release to paste the cleaned text.

    A tray icon appears in your menubar. Click it to pause dictation or quit.
